name: SRM color (calc)
description: Morey: SRM = 1.4922 × MCU^0.6859. Daniels and Mosher formulas. Unit tests required.

name: Implement @trub/calc
description: Pure calculation engine. All functions: pure inputs-in/result-out, no side effects. Must have unit tests for every function.

name: Seed data — BJCP style guidelines
description: BJCP 2021 style data: name, category number, OG/FG/IBU/SRM/ABV ranges, description. Used for stats dashboard shading.

name: F7: Recipe list page
description: Card grid: name, style, brew type, OG/IBU/ABV summary, SRM color dot, last modified, tags. Sort (newest/name/style/last modified), filter (tag/brew type/style category), full-text search. Actions: create, duplicate, delete (confirm), import BeerXML. E2E tests required.

name: OG / FG / ABV (calc)
description: OG: PPG × weight / volume adjusted for efficiency. FG: OG × yeast attenuation. ABV: simple (OG-FG)×131.25 and alternate formula. Unit tests required.

name: Root tooling
description: package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, eslint.config.js, .prettierrc.json, .gitignore

name: F10: PWA shell
description: Service Worker cache for offline support, web manifest, installable. Responsive 360px–1440px+. <2s first paint, <1s cached load.

name: Mash pH (calc)
description: Bru'n Water model (default) and Kaiser model (user-selectable). Acid addition calculations (lactic, phosphoric, acidulated malt). Unit tests required.

name: Implement @trub/types
description: Define all shared TypeScript interfaces, enums, and Zod schemas. Covers: Recipe, FermentableEntry, HopEntry, YeastEntry, MiscEntry, MashStep, FermentationStep, WaterAdjustment, EquipmentProfile, WaterProfile, StyleGuideline, UnitPreferences, RecipeUnitOverrides, and all unit/formula enums.

name: Seed data — ingredient database
description: Scrape and clean BeerXML community databases. ~200 fermentables, ~150 hops, ~200 yeast, ~50 misc. Seed data loaded into Dexie on first launch. Read-only (custom: false); users can fork into custom copies.

name: F9: Settings pages
description: Units (per-category prefs), Calculations (formula choices + doc links), Equipment Profiles (CRUD), Water Profiles (CRUD), Appearance (dark/light theme), Data (JSON backup export/import, reset to defaults).

name: IBU (calc)

name: F1: Recipe designer
description: Single vertically-scrolling page. Header (name, author, brew type), style/equipment bar, stats dashboard (OG/FG/IBU/SRM/ABV slider bars with style ranges), fermentables, hops, yeast, misc, mash schedule, fermentation schedule, water chemistry section, notes. Auto-save debounced ~1s. Recipe scaling. E2E tests required.

name: Implement @trub/app
description: Full Svelte 5 PWA: Dexie schema, repository layer, all UI features (F1–F10). All data access through repositories. All calculations via @trub/calc. Every measurement displayed via UnitValue component.

description: Define Dexie DB schema (recipes, ingredients, equipment_profiles, water_profiles, style_guidelines, settings tables). Create repository classes: RecipeRepository, IngredientRepository, EquipmentRepository, WaterProfileRepository, StyleRepository, SettingsRepository. liveQuery() subscriptions in repos, never raw Dexie in components.

name: Mash calculations (calc)
description: Strike water temp and volume, pre-boil gravity, boil-off volume. Unit tests required.

name: Seed data — equipment profiles
description: Three seed profiles: 5-gallon all-grain, 5-gallon BIAB, 1-gallon small batch. All fields per F5 spec.

name: Scaffold monorepo
description: Create the full monorepo skeleton per updated_trub_plan.md. Root tooling (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, eslint.config.js, .prettierrc.json, .gitignore), plus all five packages: @trub/types, @trub/calc, @trub/app (plain Svelte 5 + Vite + TanStack Router), @trub/sync-server (placeholder), @trub/mcp (placeholder). All lint, type-check, test, and build checks must pass at the end.

name: Unit conversions (calc)
description: SG↔Plato, SRM↔EBC↔Lovibond non-linear conversions. Linear conversions via 'convert' npm package. Unit tests required.

description: Import BeerXML 1.0 (.xml), map to Trub format, unknown ingredients → custom with warning, multi-recipe files. Export BeerXML 1.0 + styled PDF brew sheet. Evaporation rate: L/hr ↔ BeerXML % at boundary.

name: Water chemistry (calc)
description: Salt → ion contribution by weight for: gypsum, calcium chloride, Epsom salt, baking soda, chalk, table salt. Sulfate-to-chloride ratio. Unit tests required.
